info.name: BankManagement - Realistic Sample Data Full API Tests
info.description:
Postman collection aligned to 01_Combined_RealisticSampleData_And_ErrorInjection_HTML_FIXED.sql.

The collection uses the exact sample usernames, passwords, branch codes, customer national IDs, account scenarios, employee states, loan fixtures, and E01-E08 error-injection cases from that SQL file.

Run folder 00 first. It logs in all required roles and dynamically resolves database identity values, so the tests do not assume fixed CustomerID, AccountID, EmployeeID, BranchID, or LoanID values.

Folders marked OPTIONAL change database state.
